posts.title: Choosing a work bag that fits your day
posts.excerpt: Start with what you carry, then how you travel. A short guide to a work bag that keeps up.

body.text: A good work bag disappears into your routine. You stop thinking about it because everything has a place and it looks right with what you wear. Getting there starts with a few honest questions.
Start with what you carry

Empty your current bag on a table and look at what is there. Most work days need a phone, a wallet or card holder, keys and something for touch-ups. Some days add a laptop, a notebook, files or lunch.

items: If you carry a laptop, choose a bag with a padded section or room for a sleeve.
If you carry A4 files, look for a tall shape that keeps papers flat.
If you carry only the essentials, a medium bag will feel lighter and neater.

body.text: Think about the journey

How you get to work matters as much as where you work. On a matatu or walking through town, a bag that closes with a zip and sits close to the body feels calmer. If you drive, a structured tote that stands on the seat is easy to reach into.
Choose a shape that holds
Structured bags keep their shape on a desk and in meetings. Softer bags are lighter and fold into a drawer. Neither is wrong; choose the one that matches the way your day moves.
Keep the colour easy
Black, brown, tan and deep wine go with most office outfits. If you love colour, let one detail carry it, such as a beaded panel or a contrast strap.
Not sure where to start? Try the Bag Finder, or send Zuri Bags a WhatsApp message with what you carry and ask for suggestions.

posts.title: Sling, crossbody or shoulder: which suits you?
posts.excerpt: Three ways to wear a bag, and when each one makes sense.

body.text: The way a bag sits on your body changes how your whole outfit looks and how free you feel moving around. Here is a simple way to choose.
Sling and crossbody
A sling or crossbody bag sits across the body, so your hands are free and the bag stays in front of you. It is a calm choice for busy streets, markets, outings with friends and travel days.

items: Keep the strap short enough that the bag sits at your hip, not below it.
A flap or zip closure keeps things secure.
Small and medium sizes work well; large bags pull on the strap.

body.text: Shoulder bags
A shoulder bag is the everyday classic. It carries more than a sling and looks polished at work and on weekends. Look for straps long enough to sit comfortably over a jacket.
When you want both
Many bags come with a detachable strap. Carry it by the handles in the office, then clip on the strap and wear it crossbody when you head out. One bag, two looks.
In the shop, you can filter bags by how they carry: hand, shoulder, crossbody, wrist or back.

posts.title: Caring for your handbag
posts.excerpt: Simple habits that keep a bag looking good for longer.

body.text: A little care goes a long way. These are general habits that suit most bags; always check how your own bag is made before you try a new cleaning product.
Store it well

items: Stuff the bag lightly with paper or a soft cloth so it keeps its shape.
Keep it in a cloth dust bag or pillowcase, not plastic, so it can breathe.
Store it upright on a shelf rather than hanging it by the straps for long periods.
Keep it away from direct sun, which can fade colour.

body.text: Keep the inside tidy
Pens, make-up and loose coins are the usual causes of marks inside a bag. A small pouch for make-up and a card holder for coins and cards keep the lining clean.
Clean gently
Wipe the outside with a soft, dry cloth after use. For marks, try a slightly damp cloth and let the bag dry naturally, away from heat. Test any cleaner on a small hidden area first.
Mind the rain
If your bag gets wet, blot it with a dry cloth, stuff it with paper and let it dry at room temperature. Avoid hair dryers and heaters.
Rest it now and then
Rotating between two or three bags gives straps and handles a rest, and it gives your outfits a little variety too.

posts.title: One bag, three ways: work, outings and evening
posts.excerpt: How to style a single handbag from the office to the weekend to a night out.

body.text: In Zuri Bags' words, a good bag is "perfect for work, outings or elevating your everyday look." Here is how one medium handbag can do all three.
For work
Carry it by the handles or on the shoulder with a blazer or a simple dress. Keep the inside organised with a card holder and a small pouch, so you can find things quickly in a meeting.
For outings
Clip on a longer strap, if your bag has one, and wear it crossbody with jeans or a casual dress. Leave the laptop at home and enjoy a lighter bag.
For the evening
Take out everything but the essentials: phone, card, keys and a lipstick. Carry the bag by the handles or tucked under the arm, and let it sit with a dressier outfit.
Choosing a bag that can do it all

items: A medium size that is neither too big for evenings nor too small for work.
Handles plus a detachable strap, for more ways to carry.

posts.title: Choosing a clutch for weddings and evenings
posts.excerpt: Size, colour and what to put inside, so you can enjoy the night.

body.text: A clutch finishes an outfit. It should hold what you need for the evening and feel easy to carry from the ceremony to the reception and onto the dance floor.
Check the size
Before you choose, check that your phone fits. Then add a card, some cash, keys and a lipstick. If all of that closes comfortably, the clutch will do the job.
Pick a colour that works with the outfit

items: Match the clutch to your shoes for a calm, classic look.
Choose a contrast colour when your outfit is simple.
For busy prints, pick a plain clutch in one of the print's colours.

body.text: Think about your hands
Weddings mean greeting people, eating and dancing. A clutch with an optional strap lets you wear it on the shoulder or crossbody when you need both hands.
Pack light
Leave the big wallet at home. Carry one card, a little cash and your ID. A lighter clutch is easier to hold all evening.

posts.title: How to order from Zuri Bags
posts.excerpt: From choosing a bag to paying by M-Pesa Till, step by step.

body.text: Ordering from Zuri Bags happens on WhatsApp. You talk to a person who can answer questions and confirm what is available.
1. Choose your bag
Browse the shop or use the Bag Finder. On any bag, tap Order on WhatsApp, or add a few bags to your basket.
2. Send the message

WhatsApp opens with your message ready: the bag name, the price and a link. From the basket, the message lists every bag, the quantities and the subtotal, plus whether you would like to pick up at a shop or ask about delivery.
3. Wait for confirmation
Zuri Bags will reply to confirm availability. You do not pay anything until you agree in the chat.
4. Pay
Pay via M-Pesa Till, or pay at the shop when you pick up. The Till steps are on the How to order page.
